scope: Ten previously reviewed R26 sources for fit, eight new R27 sources for an untouched source test. Each has two authored target strengths, same candidate pixels, same preserve constraints and two literal languages. Use the three fixed candidates for every source. Review each output against each request. Complete, partial, failed, uncertain. The held requests are locked before their outputs are rendered; two include more indirect expressions. No changed training or scoring after held results. RGB editor only, CPU.
training: Exact pairwise ordinal differences complete > partial > failed; exclude uncertain, balance total weight by original group. Request-independent and text-conditional rankers with the same optimizer. Freeze the rule parser. Conditional feature is the interaction between parsed strength and candidate features, not the authored intent tag. Train on both literal languages, deduplicate equal parsed strengths per semantic request. Test over both languages separately, counting by original group.
baselines: Fixed mild and parsed fixed preset (+38/+77). Parser abstention yields no selection on conditional policies. No hidden fallback. Compare both parameter and pixel models. Focus on full completion, strength reversal where physically feasible, failures and language mismatch. Single AI review, no production admission.
